Southie Showdown

2023 event

This page describes the 2023 Southie Showdown, held September 30 and October 1, 2023. Registration for that event is closed.

The Southie Showdown is CrossFit Southie’s two-day competition, running since 2011. Three individual divisions let athletes test their fitness against others of similar ability, and 2023 added a coed team division of two Rx men and two Rx women.

The event welcomed everyone from new competitors to Semifinal athletes, with five workouts for all athletes and a final for the top Rx and Advanced individuals.

The movement standards below were a guide to choosing a division. Workouts could include movements and weights beyond them.

Intermediate: Men

  • Front squat, power clean and thruster for reps: 95, 75 and 75 lb
  • Chin-over-bar pull-ups
  • Hand-release push-ups
  • Single-arm dumbbell movements, 35 lb

Intermediate: Women

  • Front squat, power clean and thruster for reps: 65, 55 and 55 lb
  • Chin-over-bar pull-ups
  • Hand-release push-ups
  • Single-arm dumbbell movements, 20 lb

Rx and Team: Men

  • Front squat, power clean and thruster for reps: 135, 115 and 115 lb
  • Single-arm dumbbell movements, 50 lb
  • Chest-to-bar pull-ups and toes-to-bar
  • Handstand push-up variations

Rx and Team: Women

  • Front squat, power clean and thruster for reps: 95, 75 and 75 lb
  • Single-arm dumbbell movements, 35 lb
  • Chest-to-bar pull-ups and toes-to-bar
  • Handstand push-up variations

Advanced: Men

  • Front squat for reps, 225 lb
  • Sandbag stone proficiency, 150 lb
  • Muscle-ups and rope climbs, all variations
  • Handstand walk proficiency

Advanced: Women

  • Front squat for reps, 145 lb
  • Sandbag stone proficiency, 100 lb
  • Muscle-ups, all variations
  • Handstand walk proficiency
